sql: with f as (select distinct lo.market_ticker, lo.event_ticker, lo.created_at from live_orders lo where lo.strategy='Dmmsell10' and lo.action='buy' and lo.status='filled'), c as (select substring(f.event_ticker from position('-' in f.event_ticker)+1) as contest, f.market_ticker, row_number() over (partition by substring(f.event_ticker from position('-' in f.event_ticker)+1) order by f.created_at) as rn, coalesce((select p.realized_pnl from positions p where p.market_ticker=f.market_ticker order by p.captured_at desc limit 1),0) as realized from f) select count(*) as kept_all, round(sum(realized)::numeric,2) as actual_pnl, count(*) filter (where rn<=1) as kept_cap1, round(sum(realized) filter (where rn<=1)::numeric,2) as pnl_cap1, count(*) filter (where rn<=2) as kept_cap2, round(sum(realized) filter (where rn<=2)::numeric,2) as pnl_cap2, count(*) filter (where rn<=3) as kept_cap3, round(sum(realized) filter (where rn<=3)::numeric,2) as pnl_cap3, count(*) filter (where rn<=4) as kept_cap4, round(sum(realized) filter (where rn<=4)::numeric,2) as pnl_cap4 from c
